name: Anbernic RG353M

pad.note: same singleadc-joypad driver/ids as the RGB30

power.from: cfg (comment: "rk805 pwrkey event0, adc-keys event1, gpio-keys event2 (the volume rocker), retrogame_joypad event3")

vol.from: derived: same board as the RGB30, whose gpio-keys volume node is measured (matrix)

VOL_UP.note: dArkMossCommon.cfg default; the Standard/Swapped setting is read at boot (see notes)

VOL_DOWN.note: dArkMossCommon.cfg default; the Standard/Swapped setting is read at boot (see notes)

notes: RG353M.cfg's own header comment still reads "Powkiddy RGB30 (RK3566, 720x720) on dArkMoss" (copy-paste left over from the RGB30.cfg this file is otherwise a byte-for-byte duplicate of, aside from the Anbernic branding and a fixed, non-conditional MENU/L3/R3): a documentation quirk, not a hardware fact. RG353M.sh likewise still describes the RGB30's rumble/LED hardware verbatim.

Unlike the plain RGB30, this cfg gives MENU its own fixed code (1 316) with L3 (1 317) and R3 (1 318) staying independent stick clicks - the same fix RGB20SX.cfg applies - rather than RGB30's jq-conditional stick-click-doubles-as-MENU. No code here has been independently measured on an RG353M unit; it is inherited from the RGB30 board 1:1.

Volume rocker may be hardware-swapped on some units; RG353M.cfg carries the RGB30's same Button Settings > Volume buttons "Swapped" runtime override (B_VOLUP/DOWN become 1 114/1 115 instead of the dArkMossCommon default 1 115/1 114).
